verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only fragments of programmatic access. There is an official MCP server that authenticates with API tokens or OAuth, a CLI that can create builds, and a webhook that forwards error and project data. Nothing documents a management or data API that matches what the dashboard can do, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: a documented REST/data-access API, evidence of UI-to-API parity (triage, status changes, assignment rules, stability targets, sensitive-data tools via API), a published OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.
